```{r strat-load}
# Child section: stratified treatment-effect analysis.
# Include from report.Rmd with:
#   ```{r stratified, child = "report_stratified_section.Rmd"}
#   ```
strat <- readRDS(here::here("output", "stratified_table.rds"))
res <- strat$results
res$Stratum <- as.character(res$Stratum)

# Written summary pieces, built from the saved results (follows config.yml).
source(here::here("code", "describe_results.R"))
txt <- describe_results(strat)
```

#### Treatment Effect by `r strat$strat_name`

The adjusted odds of death for the `r strat$treatment` arm (reference: `r strat$reference`) were estimated separately within each `r strat$strat_name` category, adjusting for `r txt$covariates`. The arm × `r strat$strat_name` interaction was tested with a likelihood ratio test (p = `r sprintf("%.3f", strat$p_interaction)`).

```{r strat-text, results = "asis"}
cat(txt$overview, "\n\n")
cat("Treatment effect within each ", strat$strat_name, " category:\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", txt$strata), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n", txt$interaction, "\n\n", txt$caveat, "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r strat-table}
tab <- data.frame(
  Stratum = res$Stratum,
  `N (deaths)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", res$n, res$deaths),
  `Intervention` = sprintf("%d (%d)", res$n_intervention, res$deaths_intervention),
  `Standard` = sprintf("%d (%d)", res$n_reference, res$deaths_reference),
  `Adjusted OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", res$OR, res$lower, res$upper),
  `P-value` = sprintf("%.3f", res$p_value),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(tab, align = "lccccc")
```

```{r strat-note, results = "asis"}
if (any(res$low_events) || any(res$unstable)) {
  cat("*Note: strata with fewer than", strat$min_events,
      "deaths, or with model convergence warnings, give unstable estimates and should be interpreted cautiously.*\n")
}
```
